newsitem.title: USA: American, LAPSA to share flight codes.
newsitem.headline: American, LAPSA to share flight codes.

text.p: U.S. airline American Airlines of AMR Corp has signed an agreement with Paraguayan airliner Lineas Aereas Paraguayas (LAPSA) to share codes between Miami and Asuncion, Paraguay.
American said in a statement LAPSA would place its "PZ" designator code on American's daily service from Asuncion to its Miami hub.
In turn, American would place its "AA" code on LAPSA's daily non-stop flights between the two cities when it renewed the service in 1997, it said.
American said LAPSA had temporarily suspended the service in September.
